results.name: starting and editing raw proposal are source-only commits that preserve legacy prices and design
preview shows fresh full-section and foundation deltas including signage and landscape without committing
acceptance consumes active ID before exactly one parent commit and one Undo restores the whole prior proposal
acknowledgments neither commit nor edit the source and require explicit fresh preview
raw parent edits invalidate previews and a superseded opaque ID cannot accept a refreshed amount
same-reference catalog mutation is caught by fresh core acceptance rather than trusting preview anchors
blocked save/recovery context refuses all mutating proposal actions without history or backend writes
component reordering never redirects an acceptance or proposal edit to another index
missing or duplicate component identity cannot generate commits, previews or borrowed acknowledgment
route generation changes clear opaque previews and warning acknowledgments, including return to same source
unconfigured supports remain visible and cannot replace live prices even with all warnings acknowledged
full-section unavailability in another component blocks an otherwise valid target replacement
discard removes only the raw draft and keeps accepted definition and historical origin receipt unchanged
browser-restored raw draft never restores preview authority or warning acknowledgments
